title: 第2087章 欧阳月三个女人的变化第2086章 僵灵的适应真快
content_zh:
随着这些鬼修都完成了蜕变。
一些女修自然是有了自己的想法，特别是那些漂亮的女鬼，也是想着爬上萧天的床。
不过，她们也只是在心里想而已。
她们自然是十分清楚自己天赋！
更是知道自己与萧天的差距，在这样的差距之下，萧天怎么可能看得上她们。
除非她们着特殊的机缘。
比如秋云、秋菊以及秋韵三人那样，有着一定的炼丹天赋，如此也成了萧天的女人。
当然，前提也是足够美貌，要是没有这个基础，其他再好也难。
而秋云和秋韵和秋菊三人还是姐妹，美貌自然不用说，天赋又强，还会炼丹，不仅如此身材那是非常的完美。
特别是萧天最喜欢的地方，那是圆润，规模还十分的宏伟。这样的女人萧天自然是不会拒绝。
要是这样的女人萧天也拒绝那就对不起他色狼的名号了。
而剩下的那些鬼修之中有没有合适的？
答案自然是有的！
不过有的女人现在只专注于自己的事情，每时每刻都是在努力的工作。
其中一个管理仙米！
如今的仙米也是达到了亩产三千斤。
要知道越是高级的宝物，产量越是难提起来。
而她则是认真的呵护，让每一亩田都发挥出最大的作用。
这才有了亩产三千斤仙米的结果。
而她管理的仙米足足有数万亩！

如此多的仙米田需要她，她哪有时间去想其他的。
至于修炼，每天也是固定的那一两个时辰。
剩下的时间全部投入到了她的仙米田之中。
还有一个女人同样也是如此。
所以，在神珠世界的鬼修并不是那么轻松。
当然了，即便工作繁忙，他们的修为依然能够稳步提升，这就是这个神珠世界强大的地方。
而且他们是一直在神珠世界之中的，时间上那是相当的充裕，即便是没有刻意的去修炼，修为也不会比完美那些努力修罗修士差。
当然了，对于这些萧天并不知情。
这里的一切他都交给了原来的六大鬼王去处理。
剩下的就交给了叶净心和药仙儿。
因为药仙儿炼丹所需要的材料都是从神珠世界来的。
所以，每次需要什么药仙儿直接就是安排下去，然后自然就会送过来。
随着药仙儿突破到虚神境，炼丹的能力自然也是得到了极大的提升。
content_en:
As these ghost cultivators completed their transformation.
Some female cultivators naturally had their own ideas, especially the beautiful female ghosts, who also wanted to climb into Xiao Tian's bed.
However, they were just thinking in their hearts.
Of course they are very aware of their talents!
She also knew the gap between herself and Xiao Tian. With such a gap, how could Xiao Tian possibly like them.
Unless they have special opportunities.
For example, Qiu Yun, Qiu Ju and Qiu Yun have certain talents in alchemy, and thus they became Xiao Tian's women.
Of course, the prerequisite is that you are beautiful enough. Without this foundation, it will be difficult to achieve anything else, no matter how good you are.
Qiuyun, Qiuyun and Qiuju are sisters. Needless to say, they are beautiful, talented, and can make alchemy. Not only that, they have perfect figures.
Especially Xiao Tian's favorite place is that it is round and very grand in scale. Xiao Tian would naturally not refuse such a woman.
If Xiao Tian rejects such a woman, then he will be sorry for his reputation as a pervert.
And are there any suitable ones among the remaining ghost cultivators?
The answer is of course yes!
However, some women now only focus on their own affairs and work hard all the time.
One of them manages Xianmi!
Nowadays, the yield of fairy rice has reached 3,000 kilograms per mu.
You must know that the more advanced the treasure, the more difficult it is to raise its output.
And she takes care of it seriously, making every acre of land play its best role.
This resulted in a yield of three thousand kilograms of fairy rice per mu.
And she manages tens of thousands of acres of fairy rice!
With so many fairy fields needing her, how could she have time to think about anything else.
As for cultivation, there are also a fixed hour or two every day.
The rest of the time was devoted to her fairy rice field.
The same was true for another woman.
Therefore, ghost cultivation in the world of divine beads is not so easy.
Of course, even if they are busy at work, their cultivation can still improve steadily. This is the power of this world of divine beads.
Moreover, they have been in the world of divine beads, and they have plenty of time. Even if they do not practice deliberately, their cultivation will not be worse than those hard-working Shura monks who are perfect.
Of course, Xiao Tian didn't know anything about these.
He left everything here to the original six ghost kings.
The rest was left to Ye Jingxin and Yao Xian'er.
Because the materials Yaoxian'er needs to make alchemy all come from the world of divine beads.
Therefore, every time you need any medicine, Xianer directly arranges it, and then it will be delivered naturally.
As Yao Xian'er broke through to the Virtual God Realm, her alchemy ability was naturally greatly improved.
